name: Sound tags
description: What a recording says it is: the title, who played it, the album and the year, and the cover art inside the file — read out of ID3 in an MP3, the atoms of an M4A, a FLAC's own comments or a WAV's LIST INFO. Beside the sound viewer rather than inside it, because the machine's engine is what plays the file and it knows nothing about tags.
author: xcommander
